## Oracles
- Quoted: "Oracles: iverilog 13.0 -g2012, verilator 5.052 --binary --timing, sv2v 0.0.13 -> iverilog." (s594/COMMIT_DOCS.txt:4-5).
- Command lines: g/run4.sh (= s593's), a/run4w.sh (adds a 15 s perl alarm), r1/differential/run1.sh: iverilog -g2012 +
  vvp -n; verilator --binary --timing --assert -Wno-fatal; sv2v $S/s580/sv2v/sv2v-macOS/sv2v -> iverilog.
  Soundness batch runner r1|r2/soundness/cells/run.sh prints the first lines of PRE/POST/iverilog/verilator/sv2v.

## Verdict sources
- s594's summaries (g/c*.summ, a/cells*.summ, i/summ*/ *.summ) carry no per-cell label; g/xt.py printed per-cell
  transitions to stdout only (counts survive in i/summ/agg.txt, i/summ2/agg_*.txt, IMPL.md:78-86, 245-256).
  verdict_class is therefore `unrecorded` unless a slice record names the cell with a class:
  - i/r2_delta_pa_pb.txt (post_a -> post_b movers, `=PRE` / `!=PRE`), per <set>/<id>;
  - r1/soundness/REPORT.md, r2/soundness/REPORT.md, r1/differential/REPORT.md, r2/differential/REPORT.md (short verbatim phrase);
  - PLAN.md Audit 1 "Descents found" table, "WRONG→WRONG′ (both silent)", "🆕 AC unchanged", Audit 3 "WRONG→WRONG′".
  Matching is by cell id; md5-identical copies take the kept cell's quote.
- notes: "named at <file>:<line>" = first line of COMMIT_DOCS.txt, IMPL.md, PLAN.md, GROUNDING.md or a lens REPORT
  naming the cell; for doc-quote cells, the batch/plan line holding the oracle raw lines.
